dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The prominent 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit irregular, crenulated light-intensity perimeters. The transition shows a sharp gradient from the dark interior pixels to a high-intensity white/grey boundary line, approximately 3-8 pixels wide, before returning to a dark exterior matrix. Several annuli are interconnected, creating an interlocking chain-link geometry along the upper-left to center-right axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity clusters lacking internal gradients are concentrated in the lower-left and lower-central regions. These appear as localized, solid light-toned speckles with a low spatial density, separated by wide expanses of dark base-tone pixels. Their morphology is predominantly amorphous and lacks the structured perimeter of the annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most dorsal interlocking rings form a narrow, obtuse triangle. Connecting these to the centroid of the large, isolated central annulus creates a non-equilateral quadrilateral with the longest vector extending toward the posterior region of the visible frame.
